title: Urology and Continence Supply Program: when the previous straight-tip supply is counted from on Original Medicare refills
content:
A straight-tip intermittent catheter (A4351) refill on the Continence Original Medicare Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program counts the supply the customer still holds from the previous refill. The day that count starts depends on how the previous package reached the customer.

## Rule

The previous refill is the program's straight-tip refill with the latest ship date. The day its supply starts is set as follows:

1. **Replacement sent.** When a replacement shipment was sent for the previous refill, the previous refill's supply starts on the replacement's ship date instead.
2. **Slow delivery.** When no replacement was sent, and the proof of delivery for the previous refill shows a delivery date more than 2 calendar days after its ship date, it starts on that delivery date instead.
3. **Otherwise** it starts on the previous refill's ship date.

The records read are the previous refill's ship date, any replacement shipment recorded against it, and the carrier's proof of delivery for it.

## Cases (hypothetical; previous refill shipped on the 1st of a month)

| Replacement for the previous refill | Delivery date on its proof of delivery | Supply counted from |
|---|---|---|
| shipped on the 12th | any | the 12th |
| none | the 3rd, which is 2 days after shipping | the 1st |
| none | the 4th, which is 3 days after shipping | the 4th |
| none | no proof of delivery on file | the 1st |
